run_ImageServer_spin: run the ImageServer spin loop to receive compressed color and depth images via TCP and publish to ROS topics
run_ImageClient_spin: run the ImageClient spin loop to capture camera frames from ROS and send encoded images to a remote server
create_ImageServer: create an ImageServer instance that sets up TCP servers on ports 9990 and 9991 for receiving color and depth images
create_ImageClient: create an ImageClient instance that sets up TCP clients to send color and depth camera frames to a remote server
review_ImageServer_send_and_receive_came: review the ImageServer send_and_receive_camera_info method that updates camera info headers and publishes to ROS
